 Missed the Michigan governor debate? Watch it in full before Election Day
 Benson and James faced off on cost of living, healthcare, and education on Oct. 15.
 Samantha Sayles , Senior Digital Producer
 Published:  October 31, 2026 at 5:00 AM Tags:  Decision 2026 , Michigan , Politics The clock is ticking toward Election Day, when Michigan voters will soon choose the next governor.
 On Oct. 15, Democrat Jocelyn Benson and Republican John James went head-to-head at WDIV Local 4’s studio.
 The hour-long debate covered issues voters cared about most, including the cost of living, child education, and healthcare.
 James and Benson had little common ground, except that both agreed big changes are needed, specifically in affordability, education, and data-center policy.
 Related --> Benson, James clash over health care, Trump, Lansing record in final Michigan governor debate 
 You can watch the full debate in the video at the top of this article. 
 Election Day is on Tuesday, Nov. 3, when voters will decide on Michigan’s next governor, as well as a U.S. senator, secretary of state, attorney general, and more.
